evidence_status: Declared scenario allocations; not observed bills, lower/upper confidence bounds, or estimates of the actual complete research cost.

resource_pricing.cpu_tariff_status: Assumption applied to measured complete-process CPU; not a provider invoice.
resource_pricing.provider_attention_rate_status: Common declared sensitivity rate; not a measured human comparator quote.
resource_pricing.runtime_model_calls_scope: Only the deterministic executed pipeline; researcher model usage is separate and unknown.
resource_pricing.monetary_rounding: Integer cents, nearest-cent per modeled cost; the USD0.10 infrastructure allowance remains even when CPU cost rounds below one cent.

category_coverage.preparation_planning_execution: Measured complete deterministic execution plus infrastructure and per-opportunity prescreening allowances.
category_coverage.verification: Complete process CPU plus explicit provider attention on all attempted deliveries, including failures.
category_coverage.correction_retries: Recorded attempts remain in production evidence; per-attempt costs are charged for every modeled attempted job. Business allowance includes expected correction/support/revision effort.
category_coverage.packaging_reporting_storage: Included in measured complete process and USD0.10 per-attempt infrastructure allowance.
category_coverage.onboarding: Provider onboarding is separately charged once per first enterprise buyer: 5/15/45 minutes at USD35/hour, including failed first deliveries. It is distinct from shared setup, buyer-side integration cost and per-delivery support/revision. Actual necessary onboarding effort is unmeasured.
category_coverage.prospect_acquisition: USD1/3/10 per prospective opportunity in low/base/high schedules, including unsupported work and buyer declines; separate USD20 sensitivity. No empirical acquisition cost is known. These are allocations, not bounds. Screening is charged separately at USD0.02 per opportunity; fixed weekly overhead excludes these acquisition charges.
category_coverage.support_revision: Explicit per-attempt business allocation, uncertain and stressed; no assumption that promised revisions cost zero.
category_coverage.fees: 10% of collected invoice value in base schedules, 15% in a stress condition. Fees remain payable on later-refunded invoices.
category_coverage.refunds: Base 2% simulated refund probability after accepted collection, 10% in quality/collection stress; accrued refund obligations block reinvestment.
category_coverage.historical_research: Common prior research/discovery allocation paid from seed at opening when affordable; never relabeled operating-earned funding.
category_coverage.shared_setup: Charged once at opening, allocated across accepted deliverables only when reporting unit cost.
category_coverage.capability_investment: Separate construction, validation, failed discovery and integration allocation at modeled investment. These represent counterfactual new construction, not a claim that this completed research was paid by real receipts.
category_coverage.maintenance_obsolescence: Recurring cost for every active prerequisite; useful life is finite and stressed to eight weeks.
category_coverage.prudential_fiscal_reserve: 20% of positive operating contribution before capability outlays, 35% stress. Pure scenario reserve; no statutory tax-rate or actual liability claim.
category_coverage.fixed_reserve: USD500 protects liquidity independently of prudential fiscal reserves and accrued unpaid obligations.

allocation_integrity: Marginal compute is contained in recurring delivery cost, not added twice.
Shared construction/setup costs are paid once per modeled enterprise path.
Failed deliveries do not generate invoices and their costs remain in the accepted-deliverable denominator.
Customer savings never enter the provider cash ledger.
No token issuance, appreciation, internal transfer or future uncollected invoice is reinvestable revenue.
Actual unidentified costs remain unidentified regardless of modeled profitability.
